validated_results.title: Risk factors for renal cell carcinoma in the VITAL study.
validated_results.reason: Prospective cohort study reporting multivariable-adjusted hazard ratios for alcohol consumption and incident renal cell carcinoma.

extraction.population: VITamin And Lifestyle (VITAL) cohort participants aged 50-76 years in western Washington State

sample_size.excerpt: After median follow-up of 8 years (range 0 to 9) 249 incident cases of RCC were identified among 77,260 eligible subjects.
sample_size.location: Materials and Methods, Selection of Study Participants, paragraph 1

cases.excerpt: There were 249 incident cases of RCC.

design.excerpt: We used a prospective cohort to validate established RCC risk factors and to evaluate more controversial risk factors for incident RCC.

timing.excerpt: We used a prospective cohort to validate established RCC risk factors and to evaluate more controversial risk factors for incident RCC.

continent.excerpt: 77,260 residents of Washington aged 50-76 years completed a questionnaire between 2000-2002 on demographic, lifestyle and health data.

exposure_measurement.excerpt: Intake of alcohol, fruit and vegetables were based on a 120-item food frequency questionnaire; estimated intake was adjusted for portion size of each food item reported.
exposure_measurement.location: Materials and Methods, Baseline Data Collection, paragraph 1

smoking_status.excerpt: Smokers with more than 22.5 pack-years of exposure had a greater than 50% increased risk of RCC compared with never smokers.

extraction.ethnicity_basis: Default: no protocol-mapped specific country or population was established
